st austell.s1_head: St Austell's china-clay and professional core
s1loc: St Austell sits at the centre of Cornwall's china-clay country, where Imerys still mines and processes kaolin across more than twenty sites and remains one of the county's largest industrial employers. Around it works a layer of professional firms: Stephens Scown, whose corporate clients include Imerys and St Austell Brewery, the long-established BWM chartered accountants, and Nalders and Setfords on the legal side. St Austell Brewery itself anchors a substantial local head office and supply operation.

Beyond the clay industry, St Austell supports accountancy practices, solicitors, financial advisers and consultancies serving businesses across mid-Cornwall, with Truro's professional centre a short drive away. These are people who work in suits and meeting rooms, then step into branded polos, softshells and fleeces for conferences, away days, client and site visits, exhibitions and sponsored community events. Office managers and partners order the kit and care that the logo, colours and embroidery match the brand precisely.
